## gitlab-reviewer

Review GitLab merge requests with Claude from your terminal.

```sh
gitlab-reviewer
```

gitlab-reviewer is a terminal UI that lists GitLab merge requests, has Claude review them with full repository context, and publishes the accepted suggestions back to the MR as inline discussions.

Subcommands:

- [`cache`](#gitlab-reviewer-cache): Inspect and clean the clone cache
- [`completion`](#gitlab-reviewer-completion): Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
- [`config`](#gitlab-reviewer-config): Inspect and validate the effective configuration
- [`gui`](#gitlab-reviewer-gui): Serve the browser-based GUI
- [`models`](#gitlab-reviewer-models): List models to use with --model / review.model
- [`mr`](#gitlab-reviewer-mr): List, inspect, and approve merge requests without the TUI
- [`review`](#gitlab-reviewer-review): Run one review non-interactively (for CI and scripting)
- [`version`](#gitlab-reviewer-version): Print the gitlab-reviewer version

## gitlab-reviewer completion bash

Generate the autocompletion script for bash.

```sh
gitlab-reviewer completion bash
```

Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package. If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

```sh
source <(gitlab-reviewer completion bash)
```

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

```sh
gitlab-reviewer completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/gitlab-reviewer
```

#### macOS:

```sh
gitlab-reviewer completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/gitlab-reviewer
```

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | boolean |  | disable completion descriptions |


You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

## gitlab-reviewer gui

Serve the browser-based GUI.

```sh
gitlab-reviewer gui [flags]
```

gui starts a local web server on 127.0.0.1 and opens your browser on a session-tokenised URL. It offers the same workflow as the TUI (browse MRs, read the diff, comment, run AI reviews, curate findings, publish) with HTML rendering: syntax-highlighted diffs, a persistent file explorer, and inline discussion threads.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--no-browser` | boolean |  | do not open the browser automatically |
| `--port` | integer |  | port to listen on (default: a random free port) |

## gitlab-reviewer models

List models to use with --model / review.model.

```sh
gitlab-reviewer models
```

List the models offered for the AI review: review.models from the settings file when set, otherwise a curated list of common Claude models for the selected provider. The list is suggestions only: --model accepts any model ID the claude CLI understands.

## gitlab-reviewer mr

List, inspect, and approve merge requests without the TUI.

mr covers the merge request side of a headless review: list MRs with the same filters as the GUI, inspect one, and approve or unapprove it. Every subcommand supports --output json for agents and scripts, and never prompts.

Subcommands:

- [`approve`](#gitlab-reviewer-mr-approve): Approve a merge request (honours gate.approvals: block)
- [`list`](#gitlab-reviewer-mr-list): List merge requests with the GUI's filters
- [`show`](#gitlab-reviewer-mr-show): Show one merge request: detail, commits, pipeline, threads, rebase state
- [`unapprove`](#gitlab-reviewer-mr-unapprove): Remove your approval from a merge request

## gitlab-reviewer mr approve

Approve a merge request (honours gate.approvals: block).

```sh
gitlab-reviewer mr approve <project!iid | MR URL> [flags]
```

approve approves the merge request as the configured GitLab user. The approval is pinned to a head commit: --sha when given (for example the head_sha of the review you acted on), otherwise the MR's current head, so GitLab refuses it if the MR moved on. With gate.min_severity set and gate.approvals: block, an MR whose latest stored review still has blocking findings is not approved and the command exits 2.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` | string | `text` | result format on stdout: text\|json |
| `--sha` | string |  | head commit the approval applies to (default: the MR's current head) |

## gitlab-reviewer mr list

List merge requests with the GUI's filters.

```sh
gitlab-reviewer mr list [flags]
```

list prints merge requests in the configured scope (gitlab.projects and gitlab.groups), newest activity first, with the latest stored review of each. --project and --group replace the configured scope for this call.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |

| `--state` | string | `opened` | merge request state: opened\|merged\|closed\|all |
| `--target` | string |  | target branch |

## gitlab-reviewer review

Run one review non-interactively (for CI and scripting).

```sh
gitlab-reviewer review <project!iid | MR URL> [flags]
```

review runs the AI review for one merge request without the TUI: it checks the MR branch out, runs the configured review agents, stores the result (reopenable later in the TUI or GUI), and optionally publishes the findings. Progress streams to stderr; the outcome is written to stdout as text or JSON. The merge request is named as project!iid (e.g. mygroup/myapp!123; in GitLab CI that is "$CI_PROJECT_PATH!$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID") or as its web URL, whose host also selects the matching gitlab.instances entry.

By default nothing is posted to GitLab (--publish none): findings are only stored and reported. --publish immediate posts every finding as it resolves; --publish draft collects them into a draft review and publishes it in one action.

When the MR already has a stored review, the run is incremental: only the changes pushed since the last reviewed commit go through the review passes, and the previous findings, including their accepted, rejected, and published states, carry forward (findings whose code changed are dropped). It falls back to a full review after a rebase or when the last reviewed commit is unreachable. Pass --full to scan the entire diff again regardless.

Subcommands:

- [`accept`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-accept): Accept findings for publishing
- [`accept-all`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-accept-all): Accept every pending finding
- [`edit`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-edit): Replace a finding's comment body
- [`list`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-list): List the stored reviews of a merge request, newest first
- [`publish`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-publish): Publish the accepted findings of a stored review to the MR
- [`reject`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-reject): Reject findings so they are never published
- [`show`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-show): Show a stored review with its findings, ids, and states
- [`submit`](#gitlab-reviewer-review-submit): Submit the MR's pending draft review, publishing its draft comments

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--full` | boolean |  | review the whole diff even when a stored review allows an incremental run |
| `--output` | string | `text` | result format on stdout: text\|json |
| `--publish` | string | `none` | publish findings to the MR: none\|draft\|immediate |

## gitlab-reviewer review accept

Accept findings for publishing.

```sh
gitlab-reviewer review accept <project!iid | MR URL> <finding-id>... [flags]
```

The change is saved to the stored review (the newest unless --record names one), exactly as triaging in the TUI or GUI does. Nothing is posted to GitLab until review publish.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` | string | `text` | result format on stdout: text\|json |
| `--record` | string |  | stored review to use, by its record name from review list (default: the newest) |

## gitlab-reviewer review publish

Publish the accepted findings of a stored review to the MR.

```sh
gitlab-reviewer review publish <project!iid | MR URL> [flags]
```

publish posts only the accepted findings of a stored review (the newest unless --record names one) through the same publisher as the TUI and GUI, skipping findings that restate a comment already on the MR, and records each finding's outcome back into the review. --mode defaults to publish.mode. In draft mode the comments wait in a pending draft review until `review submit`. Exits non-zero when any finding failed to post.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--mode` | string |  | draft (a pending review, see review submit) or immediate (default: publish.mode) |
| `--output` | string | `text` | result format on stdout: text\|json |
| `--record` | string |  | stored review to use, by its record name from review list (default: the newest) |

## Global flags

Accepted by every command. Each one sets the configuration key in the second column, with the precedence flags, then environment, then settings file, then defaults.

| Flag | Setting | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-concurrency` | [`review.agent_concurrency`](../configuration/#review.agent_concurrency) | integer | how many agent passes run at once (default 3) |
| `--agents` | [`review.agents`](../configuration/#review.agents) | comma-separated, repeatable | review agents to run (builtin: bug,security,performance,docs,style,design; plus custom agents by name) |
| `--aggregate` | [`review.aggregate`](../configuration/#review.aggregate) | boolean | merge duplicate findings across agents with the aggregation agent (--aggregate=false uses the deterministic heuristic) |
| `--attribution` | [`publish.attribution`](../configuration/#publish.attribution) | boolean | append an attribution footer to published comments |
| `--auto-comment` | [`publish.auto_comment`](../configuration/#publish.auto_comment) | boolean | publish findings at/above --auto-min-severity without confirmation |
| `--auto-min-severity` | [`publish.auto_min_severity`](../configuration/#publish.auto_min_severity) | string | severity threshold for --auto-comment (info\|minor\|major\|critical) |
| `--aws-profile` | [`bedrock.profile`](../configuration/#bedrock.profile) | string | AWS profile for Bedrock |
| `--aws-region` | [`bedrock.region`](../configuration/#bedrock.region) | string | AWS region for Bedrock |
| `--bare` | [`review.bare`](../configuration/#review.bare) | boolean | run claude with --bare (skips user hooks/CLAUDE.md; breaks OAuth auth) |
| `--cache-dir` | [`checkout.cache_dir`](../configuration/#checkout.cache_dir) | string | cache directory for clones and worktrees |
| `--cache-max-mb` | [`checkout.cache_max_mb`](../configuration/#checkout.cache_max_mb) | integer | clone cache size budget in MiB |
| `--checkout-mode` | [`checkout.mode`](../configuration/#checkout.mode) | string | repo checkout mode: clone\|path\|root |
| `--claude-path` | [`review.claude_path`](../configuration/#review.claude_path) | string | path to the claude binary |
| `--clone-transport` | [`checkout.transport`](../configuration/#checkout.transport) | string | clone/fetch transport: https\|ssh |
| `--config` | n/a | string | path to settings file (default ~/.config/gitlab-reviewer/config.yaml) |
| `--diff-view` | [`ui.diff_view`](../configuration/#ui.diff_view) | string | diff layout in the MR detail screen: unified\|split |
| `--exclude` | [`review.exclude`](../configuration/#review.exclude) | repeatable | glob of files to exclude from review, repeatable |
| `--fallback-to-note` | [`publish.fallback_to_note`](../configuration/#publish.fallback_to_note) | boolean | post a general MR note when an inline position cannot be resolved |
| `--file-explorer` | [`ui.file_explorer`](../configuration/#ui.file_explorer) | string | initial state of the changed-files explorer in the MR detail screen: open\|closed |
| `--gate-approvals` | [`gate.approvals`](../configuration/#gate.approvals) | string | approving while blocking findings remain: off\|warn\|block |
| `--gate-min-severity` | [`gate.min_severity`](../configuration/#gate.min_severity) | string | findings at/above this severity are blocking: the review command exits 2 and approvals warn or block (info\|minor\|major\|critical) |
| `--git-root` | [`checkout.root`](../configuration/#checkout.root) | string | structured git root, e.g. ~/git (checkout-mode=root) |
| `--gitlab-base-url` | [`gitlab.base_url`](../configuration/#gitlab.base_url) | string | GitLab base URL (default https://gitlab.com) |
| `--gitlab-token` | [`gitlab.token`](../configuration/#gitlab.token) | string | GitLab access token (prefer GITLAB_REVIEWER_GITLAB_TOKEN) |
| `--group` | [`gitlab.groups`](../configuration/#gitlab.groups) | repeatable | group path to browse, repeatable |
| `--instance` | [`gitlab.default_instance`](../configuration/#gitlab.default_instance) | string | named GitLab instance to use (see gitlab.instances) |
| `--instructions` | [`review.instructions`](../configuration/#review.instructions) | string | extra review instructions appended to the prompt |
| `--instructions-file` | [`review.instructions_file`](../configuration/#review.instructions_file) | string | file with extra review instructions |
| `--keep-worktree` | [`checkout.keep`](../configuration/#checkout.keep) | boolean | keep review worktrees after the review |
| `--local-overlay` | [`checkout.local_overlay`](../configuration/#checkout.local_overlay) | repeatable | glob of untracked files copied from the local clone into the review worktree, repeatable (path/root modes) |
| `--log-file` | [`log.file`](../configuration/#log.file) | string | log file path |
| `--log-level` | [`log.level`](../configuration/#log.level) | string | log level: debug\|info\|warn\|error |
| `--max-budget-usd` | [`review.max_budget_usd`](../configuration/#review.max_budget_usd) | number | maximum spend per review in USD, shared across the selected agents |
| `--max-diff-kb` | [`review.max_diff_kb`](../configuration/#review.max_diff_kb) | integer | diff budget sent to Claude, in KiB |
| `--model` | [`review.model`](../configuration/#review.model) | string | model passed to the claude CLI |
| `--models` | [`review.models`](../configuration/#review.models) | comma-separated, repeatable | models offered by the models command and --model completion (default: curated per-provider list) |
| `--per-page` | [`gitlab.per_page`](../configuration/#gitlab.per_page) | integer | GitLab API page size |
| `--project` | [`gitlab.projects`](../configuration/#gitlab.projects) | repeatable | project path to browse, repeatable (group/app) |
| `--provider` | [`review.provider`](../configuration/#review.provider) | string | AI provider: anthropic\|bedrock |
| `--publish-min-severity` | [`publish.min_severity`](../configuration/#publish.min_severity) | string | publish floor: findings below it are never posted (info\|minor\|major\|critical) |
| `--publish-mode` | [`publish.mode`](../configuration/#publish.mode) | string | publish mode: draft\|immediate |
| `--publish-template` | [`publish.template`](../configuration/#publish.template) | string | comment body template ({{.severity}} {{.category}} {{.agent}} {{.title}} {{.body}} {{.file}}); e.g. '{{.body}}' for plain comments |
| `--repo-path` | [`checkout.path`](../configuration/#checkout.path) | string | existing local clone (checkout-mode=path) |
| `--review-env` | [`review.env`](../configuration/#review.env) | repeatable | extra KEY=VALUE env for the claude subprocess, repeatable |
| `--review-timeout` | [`review.timeout`](../configuration/#review.timeout) | duration | maximum duration for one review |
| `--use-agents` | [`review.use_agents`](../configuration/#review.use_agents) | boolean | let the reviewer delegate to Claude Code subagents (.claude/agents) |
